games.name: Bedwarz ⚔️
games.desc:
🏁 Goal of this game:

- Collect resources 💎
- Break beds 🛏️
- Defeat all teams ⚔️
- Win 🏆

💻 Controls:

- Shift to sprint
- Ctrl to shiftlock
- Hold down left click to auto swing or auto build
- E to open backpack
- V for picture mode

🎮 Console:

- R1: Equip item forward
- L1: Equip item backward
- R2: Activate item
- B: Drop item
- X: Sprint
- Y: Shiftlock
- DPad: Item shop selector / Upgrade selector
- L2: Purchase / Upgrade

🐛 Leave a bug report on the group wall if you found one!

☄️ Updates are random
